title: Cursor Pricing in 2026: Every Plan | Coworker AI

facts.fact: Cursor's Premium team seat costs $30 per user per month and carries the same weekly usage as the individual Premium plan.
facts.quote: **Premium seat**: $30/user/month, with the same weekly usage as the individual Premium plan.

facts.fact: Cursor's Super team seat costs $100 per user per month and includes 3.75x Premium's weekly usage.
facts.quote: **Super seat**: $100/user/month, with 3.75x Premium's weekly usage.

facts.fact: Cursor's Ultra team seat costs $200 per user per month and includes 12.5x Premium's weekly usage.
facts.quote: **Ultra seat**: $200/user/month, with 12.5x Premium's weekly usage.

facts.fact: Cursor's Free team seat costs $0 and has no team usage allowance, so that member's usage draws from their personal plan.
facts.quote: A **Free seat** ($0) is also available; it has no team usage allowance, so that member's usage draws from their own personal plan.

facts.fact: Teams created before October 12 keep legacy Standard seats at $40 and Premium seats at $120 unless they switch.
facts.quote: Teams created before October 12 keep legacy Standard ($40) and Premium ($120) seats with monthly pools and on-demand usage unless they switch.

facts.fact: Cursor bills teams per active paid seat, with upgrades applied immediately at a pro-rated charge and downgrades applied at the end of the billing period.
facts.quote: billing is per active paid seat rather than a fixed headcount: upgrades apply right away at a pro-rated charge, and downgrades apply at the end of the billing period.

facts.fact: On The X Subscription, Cursor's displayed plan prices exclude tax, with the legacy India-only Start plan at ₹649 tax inclusive as the exception.
facts.quote: Every plan on The X Subscription displays its price before tax (the legacy India-only Start plan, at ₹649 tax inclusive, is the exception)

facts.fact: Cursor's Teams restructuring changed seat plans on October 12, when The X Subscription replaced the June Standard and Premium seats with three tiers priced like the individual plans.
facts.quote: On October 12, The X Subscription replaced those seats with three tiers priced like the individual plans.

facts.fact: Cursor's Teams table lists a $0.25 per million tokens charge on Teams and Enterprise for its meter, in addition to third-party models at API list price from prepaid credit.
facts.quote: plus $0.25 per million tokens on Teams and Enterprise

facts.fact: GitHub Copilot Pro costs $10 per month and includes 1,500 AI credits according to the comparison table.
facts.quote: Pro $10/month, 1,500 AI credits

facts.fact: GitHub's plan documentation sets Copilot Pro at $10 per month with 1,000 base plus 500 flex credits.
facts.quote: sets Pro at $10/month with 1,000 base plus 500 flex credits

facts.fact: GitHub Copilot Pro+ costs $39 per month with 7,000 credits, and Max costs $100 per month with 20,000 credits, per GitHub's plan documentation.
facts.quote: Pro+ at $39 with 7,000, Max at $100 with 20,000

facts.fact: GitHub Copilot Business costs $19 per granted seat with 1,900 credits per user, and Enterprise costs $39 per seat with 3,900 credits.
facts.quote: Business at $19 per granted seat with 1,900 credits per user, and Enterprise at $39 per seat with 3,900.

facts.fact: GitHub Copilot overage is billed at a flat $0.01 per AI credit, and completions are excluded from metering.
facts.quote: Overage is a flat $0.01 per AI credit, credits pool across an enterprise, and completions are excluded from metering entirely.

facts.fact: Anthropic's Claude Code cost documentation states the average across enterprise deployments is around $13 per developer per active day.
facts.unit: USD per developer per active day
facts.quote: across enterprise deployments the average is around $13 per developer per active day

facts.fact: Anthropic's Claude Code cost documentation states the typical monthly cost is $150 to $250 per developer, with 90% of users below $30 per active day.
facts.quote: $150 to $250 per developer per month, with 90% of users staying below $30 per active day

facts.fact: Claude Pro costs $17 per month on annual billing or $20 monthly, Max starts at $100 per month, and Team seats cost $20 or $100 per seat on annual billing, per Claude's pricing page.
facts.quote: Pro at $17/month on annual billing or $20 monthly, Max from $100/month, and Team seats at $20 or $100 per seat on annual billing

facts.fact: Devin's pricing, shown at windsurf.com/pricing as of October 19, 2026, lists Pro at $20 per month, Max at $200 per month, and Teams at $80 per month plus $40 per month per full dev seat.
facts.quote: Pro at $20/month, Max at $200/month, Teams at $80/month for the team plan plus $40/month per full dev seat

facts.fact: Superblocks, a third-party source, argues Cursor's $20 Pro plan pays for itself if it saves even one hour of billable time a month.
facts.quote: Pro's $20 pays for itself if it saves even an hour of billable time a month

facts.fact: Coworker AI reports that Cursor's Plus plan costs $8 and covers Agent with Cursor models at fixed settings, but not Auto, Cloud Agents or third-party models.
facts.quote: Plus at $8 covers Agent with Cursor models at fixed settings, but not Auto, Cloud Agents or third-party models.

facts.fact: Coworker AI reports that Cursor's Premium seat costs $30 per month, or $300 per year (equivalent to $25/month).
facts.quote: Premium at $30 ($300 a year, or $25/month equivalent) is the first tier with those.

facts.fact: Coworker AI reports that Cursor recommends its Super plan at $100 for daily Agent users.
facts.quote: Cursor recommends Super at $100 for daily Agent users, and that covers the Cursor-model side.

facts.fact: Coworker AI reports that Cursor's Ultra plan costs $200.
facts.quote: Ultra at $200 only makes sense once a few weeks of data show the Super pool running out

facts.fact: Coworker AI reports that Cursor charges a Cursor Token Rate of $0.25 per million tokens on third-party model traffic.
facts.quote: plus the Cursor Token Rate of $0.25 per million tokens, so 100 million tokens of third-party traffic in a month adds $25

facts.fact: In Coworker AI's illustrative 10-person team scenario (seven Premium seats and three Super seats), seat cost totals $510 per month.
facts.quote: Seven seats at $30 plus three at $100 is $210 plus $300, or $510/month in seats.

facts.fact: In Coworker AI's illustrative 40-developer scenario (30 Premium and 10 Super seats), list seat cost is $1,900 per month or $22,800 per year before third-party usage.
facts.quote: That is 30 times $30 plus 10 times $100, or $1,900/month, $22,800/year, before any third-party usage.

facts.fact: Coworker AI states that Cursor's annual Premium price is $300 versus $360 when billed monthly, which it describes as two months free.
facts.quote: Premium is $300 a year instead of $360

facts.fact: Coworker AI cites Anthropic's published rates showing Claude Sonnet 5 input at $2 per million tokens versus $0.20 per million for cache reads.
facts.quote: $2 versus $0.20 per million on Claude Sonnet 5 at published rates

facts.fact: Coworker AI gives an illustrative example that a legacy Pro user who mostly runs Claude would pay $30 for Premium plus third-party credit, against $20 today.
facts.quote: Someone on legacy Pro who mostly runs Claude would pay $30 for Premium plus third-party credit, against $20 today.

facts.fact: Coworker AI reports that GitHub Copilot Business costs $19 with a fixed credit allowance.
facts.quote: Copilot Business at $19 with a fixed credit allowance is the more honest fit.

facts.fact: Coworker AI reports that GitHub Copilot Pro costs $10 per month and covers unlimited code completions, about a third of Cursor Premium's price.
facts.quote: Copilot Pro at $10/month covers unlimited code completions, a third of Cursor Premium's price.

facts.fact: Coworker AI says the cheapest and most expensive published model rates differ by roughly 20 times.
facts.quote: Given the roughly 20x spread between the cheapest and most expensive published rates

facts.fact: On The X Subscription, which new customers have bought since October 12, 2026, Plus costs $8/month.
facts.quote: On The X Subscription, which new customers have bought since October 12, 2026: Free, Plus $8/month, Premium $30/month, Super $100/month and Ultra $200/month.

facts.fact: Cursor Teams seats cost $30, $100 or $200 per user per month on The X Subscription, and Enterprise is priced on request.
facts.quote: Teams seats cost $30, $100 or $200 per user per month, and Enterprise is priced on request.

facts.fact: Legacy Cursor plans (Pro $20, Pro+ $60, Ultra $200, Teams $40 or $120 per seat) continue for existing subscribers.
facts.quote: Legacy plans (Pro $20, Pro+ $60, Ultra $200, Teams $40 or $120 per seat) continue for existing subscribers.

facts.fact: On The X Subscription, annual billing is $80/year for Plus, $300 for Premium, $1,000 for Super and $2,000 for Ultra, which the page says works out to two months free; prices exclude tax.
facts.quote: On The X Subscription, annual billing is $80/year for Plus, $300 for Premium, $1,000 for Super and $2,000 for Ultra, which works out to two months free.

facts.fact: The Cursor Token Rate is $0.25 per million tokens and applies on Teams and Enterprise plans to third-party model requests, on top of that model's API price.
facts.quote: It is a $0.25 per million token charge that applies on Teams and Enterprise plans to third-party model requests, on top of that model's API price.

facts.fact: On The X Subscription, 10 Premium seats cost $300/month, and moving three heaviest users to Super seats raises that to $510/month before any third-party usage.
facts.quote: On The X Subscription, 10 Premium seats cost $300/month. Moving the three heaviest users to Super seats raises that to $510/month before any third-party usage

facts.fact: Per the page, GitHub Copilot Pro costs $10/month, compared with Cursor Premium at $30/month.
facts.quote: Copilot Pro is $10/month against Cursor Premium's $30 (Cursor Plus is $8 but covers only Cursor's own models)

facts.fact: Per the page, GitHub Copilot Business costs $19 per seat, compared with Cursor Teams at $30 per seat.
facts.quote: and Copilot Business is $19 per seat against Cursor Teams at $30.

facts.fact: Per the page, GitHub Copilot charges a flat $0.01 per AI credit on overage.
facts.quote: Copilot also excludes code completions from metering entirely and charges a flat $0.01 per AI credit on overage.

facts.fact: Cursor's privacy mode is described on its pricing page as a guarantee that code data is not used for training by Cursor or its model providers, and it is not an on-premise deployment.
facts.quote: Cursor's answer to data concerns is privacy mode, which its pricing page describes as a guarantee that code data is not used for training by Cursor or its model providers.

facts.fact: On Cursor, group-level spend limits are available only on Enterprise, while Teams admins can set a default limit per member on The X Subscription.
facts.quote: Teams admins can also set a default limit per member with per-member overrides. Group-level spend limits are Enterprise-only.

facts.fact: Cursor's own pricing and model-cost features: third-party models bill at API list price from prepaid credit on The X Subscription, and are never in the included pool.
facts.quote: On The X Subscription those are never in the included pool: they bill at API list price from prepaid credit.

facts.fact: In an Ahrefs SERP check on October 19, 2026, cursor.com held the top organic result with five sitelinks.
facts.quote: In an Ahrefs SERP check on October 19, 2026, cursor.com held the top organic result with five sitelinks

facts.fact: Coworker MCP, per the vendor, connects AI tooling to 50+ apps through one governed connection.
facts.quote: through one governed connection to 50+ apps rather than a pile of individually-installed servers.
